category: Data Processing Policies, Processes, and Procedures (CT.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures for authorizing data processing (e.g., organizational decisions, individual consent), revoking authorizations, and maintaining authorizations are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-8 (Identification and Authentication — privacy analogue); CM-3 (Configuration Change Control)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.34 (Privacy and PII protection)
GDPR Art. 7 (Conditions for consent), Art. 18 (Right to restriction)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AA-01 (identities provisioned)
implementation_examples: Define policies, processes, and procedures for authorising data processing (organisational decisions, individual consent) and for revoking and maintaining authorisations over time
Provide consent UI that records granular, demonstrable, and revocable authorisations
Tie processing-authorisation state to data processing infrastructure so that processing halts on revocation
assessment_objectives: Determine whether data-processing authorisation policies exist
Determine whether consent and revocation are captured with granularity and auditability
Determine whether processing halts automatically on revocation
Determine whether organisational decisions are documented alongside individual consent
